title: Transdiagnostic effects of medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS): A systematic review and meta-analysis of sham-controlled trials
title_zh: 内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）的超诊断效应：一项假刺激对照试验的系统评价与荟萃分析
abstract: BACKGROUND: There is a growing body of evidence to support the role of the medial prefrontal cortex (mPFC) as having a central role in a variety of psychiatric disorders. Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has been investigated over the mPFC in multiple recent sham-controlled trials. However, no meta-analysis of transdiagnostic symptoms across psychiatric disorders has been undertaken. OBJECTIVES: This systematic review and meta-analysis (CRD42022354346) examined the transdiagnostic symptoms of rTMS to the mPFC for a number of psychiatric diagnoses. METHODS: The analysis included randomised, sham-controlled trials of rTMS to the mPFC for psychiatric disorders. The key outcomes were change in clinical symptoms, quality of life, and cognition measures from pre- to post- treatment, in symptom domains including depression, anxiety, obsessive compulsive symptoms, negative symptoms, craving, and consumption. FINDINGS: We retrieved 3,901 records, 176 were screened at full text, and 30 were included. Seventeen symptom domains and 1,083 participants were analysed. rTMS to the mPFC produced moderate to large effects for obsessive compulsive symptoms, moderate effects for negative symptoms and craving, and small effects for depressive symptoms. Effects for anxiety, cognition, consumption and impulsivity were non-significant. Interpretation was limited by the overall small number of studies, high heterogeneity in findings and some concerns of risk of bias. CONCLUSION: This systematic review and meta-analysis suggests that rTMS over the mPFC may have therapeutic potential for obsessive-compulsive symptoms, negative symptoms, and craving, with modest effects for depressive symptoms. Further high-quality, adequately-powered trials are needed to confirm effects and clarify optimal stimulation protocols.
abstract_zh: 背景：越来越多证据支持内侧前额叶皮层（mPFC）在多种精神障碍中发挥核心作用。近期多项假刺激对照试验已对 mPFC 应用重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）进行研究。然而，尚未针对精神障碍中的跨诊断症状开展荟萃分析。目标：本系统评价与荟萃分析（CRD42022354346）考察了 rTMS 对 mPFC 在多种精神诊断中的跨诊断症状效应。方法：纳入精神障碍中针对 mPFC 的随机、假刺激控制 rTMS 试验。主要结局为治疗前后临床症状、生活质量和认知测量的变化，涵盖抑郁、焦虑、强迫症状、阴性症状、渴求和消费等症状领域。结果：共检索到 3,901 条记录，176 条全文纳入筛选，30 条被纳入。分析涉及 17 个症状领域和 1,083 名参与者。mPFC rTMS 对强迫症状产生中等至较大效应，对阴性症状和渴求产生中等效应，对抑郁症状产生小效应。焦虑、认知、消费和冲动性方面的效应无统计学意义。解释受到总体研究数量较少、结果异质性较高以及部分偏倚风险顾虑的限制。结论：本系统评价与荟萃分析提示，mPFC rTMS 可能对强迫症状、阴性症状和渴求具有治疗潜力，对抑郁症状的影响较小。需要更多高质量、样本量充足的试验来验证效应并明确最佳刺激方案。
